scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist','tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @boringstack/i18n build && pnpm --filter @boringstack/db build && pnpm --filter @boringstack/api build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.openapi:export: pnpm --filter @boringstack/i18n build && pnpm --filter @boringstack/db build && pnpm --filter @boringstack/api build && cd ../.. && npx nestia all --config nestia.config.ts --project packages/api/tsconfig.json && cd apps/api && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=../../packages/api/tsconfig.json node --import tsx ../../packages/api/scripts/export-openapi.ts
